'''Daniel Segal''' (born 1947)<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.science.unitn.it/~caranti/Conferences/PAGT2007/ |title=2007 website for a mathematical conference held on the 60th birthday of Dan Segal |access-date=30 May 2010 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304031735/http://www.science.unitn.it/~caranti/Conferences/PAGT2007/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> is a British [[mathematician]] and a Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Oxford]]. He specialises in [[algebra]] and [[group theory]].

He studied at [[Peterhouse, Cambridge]], before taking a [[PhD]] at [[Queen Mary, University of London|Queen Mary College]], [[University of London]], in 1972, supervised by [[Bertram Wehrfritz]], with a dissertation on [[group theory]] entitled ''Groups of [[Automorphism]]s of Infinite [[Soluble Group]]s''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=52887}}</ref> He is an Emeritus Fellow of [[All Souls College]] at Oxford, where he was sub-warden from 2006 to 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.all-souls.ox.ac.uk/people.php?personid=62 |title=Professor Daniel Segal, sub-warden |access-date=18 October 2012 |archive-date=21 April 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150421192137/http://www.all-souls.ox.ac.uk/people.php?personid=62 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20121223185938/http://www.maths.ox.ac.uk/people/profiles/dan.segal|title=Homepage in Oxford}}</ref>

His postgraduate students have included [[Marcus du Sautoy]] and [[Geoff Smith (mathematician)|Geoff Smith]]. He is the son of psychoanalyst [[Hanna Segal]] and brother of philosopher [[Gabriel Segal (philosopher)|Gabriel Segal]] as well as Michael Segal, a senior civil servant.
